Introduction

What is RoboMate Cloud Automation?

RoboMate Cloud Automation is a project created to analyze and manage cloud cost, usage, security, and governance—all in one place. With RoboMate Cloud Automation, you can:

  • Build an inventory of your cloud infrastructure assets.
  • Control your resource usage and gain visibility across all used services for maximum cost-effectiveness.
  • Detect potential vulnerabilities that could put your cloud environment at risk using industry-leading cloud security standards.
  • Use built-in reports to gain comprehensive visibility over all cloud aspects.
  • Get a deep understanding of how you spend on Azure, AWS, OCI, Google Cloud, and Huawei Cloud.
  • Visualize every network of a region together (VNets, VPCs, VCNs, subnets, routes, peerings, and resources) in the Charts view.
  • Just like an expert—use any of RoboMate's automation profiles to convert hours of work into minutes when building, developing, and securing cloud environments.

Introduction

RoboMate Cloud Automation is a powerful AI-driven assessment and automation tool designed to enhance cloud productivity and help you achieve your goals effortlessly. Featuring a user-friendly interface, RoboMate equips architects, engineers, and DevOps teams with comprehensive tools and intelligent algorithms to optimize their cloud workloads.

This cutting-edge solution employs robust frameworks that effectively manage various cloud services. By leveraging these frameworks, teams can streamline operations while ensuring reliability, security, cost efficiency, and peak performance.

Core Pillars

  • Reliability: Through intelligent monitoring and automation, RoboMate continuously oversees cloud resources, swiftly detecting and resolving issues. This proactive approach ensures applications remain highly available and perform optimally—minimizing downtime and disruptions.
  • Security: RoboMate incorporates advanced encryption techniques and robust authentication mechanisms to safeguard sensitive data and prevent unauthorized access. Built-in security assessments validate configurations against cloud-native and CISA standards, giving you confidence that your workloads are protected.
  • Cost Optimization: Using advanced algorithms and predictive analytics, RoboMate identifies underused resources, idle assets, and licensing inefficiencies—delivering actionable recommendations to reduce waste and maximize ROI.
  • Performance: RoboMate monitors resource utilization in real time, pinpoints bottlenecks, and suggests tuning strategies to enhance application responsiveness and end-user experience.

RoboMate Cloud Automation supports six cloud platforms—Microsoft Azure, Amazon Web Services (AWS), Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI), Google Cloud (GCP), Huawei Cloud, and Microsoft Entra ID / Office 365—with a strong emphasis on reliability, availability, security, cost efficiency, and performance.

RoboMate runs as the RoboMate web console: RoboMate Console starts it on your machine and opens it in your browser, where every cloud, report, automation, tool, and RoboMate AI is one click away.

Team

  • Marco Fekry – Developer and Owner. Multi-Cloud Service Delivery Manager and Technical Expert with over 17 years of experience in IT, specializing in Azure, AWS, OCI, Entra ID, and Office 365.

Installation Instructions

  1. Request your RoboMate Cloud Automation license and installer from info@robomatecloud.com
  2. Run RoboMate-Installer.ps1 from an elevated (Run as administrator) PowerShell window
  3. Add your license when the installer asks for it
  4. The installer installs the prerequisites for the clouds in your license (.NET 8 runtimes, PowerShell 7, Google Cloud SDK, Huawei KooCLI, cloud modules)
  5. The installer installs RoboMate Console in C:\RoboMate v3.6\net6.0-windows7.0 and creates the desktop shortcut
  6. Start RoboMate Console: it starts the web console and opens http://RoboMateCloudAutomation:5080 in your browser
  7. Choose Start, then pick a cloud on the Cloud Providers screen and sign in

Repair: run RoboMate-Installer-Repair.ps1 to reinstall missing prerequisites or the console. Updates: RoboMate Console checks for a new version every time it starts; administrators can also update from Profile → Updates. Your license, settings and assessments are kept during updates.

RoboMate Web Console

The RoboMate web console brings the full RoboMate experience to your browser. RoboMate Console (the RoboMate desktop icon) starts it in the background, opens it at http://RoboMateCloudAutomation:5080, and stops it cleanly. Assessments and automations run on the machine where RoboMate is installed; the browser shows the progress live.

🔑 License & Start

Add or change your license, see your modules, expiry date, and the remaining assessments and deployments.

☁️ Cloud Providers

All six clouds on one screen with the signed-in (or last) tenant, account, subscription, project, or region of each. The top-right controls give Documentation, Profile, Admin, About, theme, and Sign out.

🔐 Sign-in

Every cloud opens through its sign-in page: new credentials, Previous Access Connect, or RoboMate Local Access to review saved assessments offline.

🏠 Assessment Home

Run, follow, and cancel assessments with live progress, CPU and memory monitors. Detected resources appear as tiles with counts; double-click any grid to open the resource details page with analytics.

💰 Cost

Cost views per cloud: KPI tiles, service and resource pies, analytics cards, and click-to-filter bars.

🗺️ Charts

Region view of all networks with subnets, resources, routes, peerings, and hubs for Azure, AWS, OCI, Google Cloud, and Huawei Cloud, plus the Azure resource group topology.

📑 Reports

Build any report of the last assessment, preview it in the console, download it, or export the full assessment data to Excel.

🚀 Deploy / Update / Delete / Migrate

Each automation opens with its architecture diagram, notes, grouped parameters, validation, and the RoboMate Shell for interactive answers.

🔍 AI Search

Search the assessment of any cloud in plain language or chat with RoboMate AI about it.

🗂️ Previous Assessments & Logs

Restore archived assessments, delete old ones, and review the assessment and automation logs.

👤 Profile

Your details, company logo (shown on every report), and RoboMate updates.

🛡️ Secure by Design

License, settings, and activity are stored encrypted; sign-in protected console; dark and light themes.

RoboMate Assessments

RoboMate Assessments

RoboMate Cloud Automation provides a comprehensive set of multi-cloud assessments designed to give full visibility into your cloud environments. These assessments analyze configurations, usage patterns, security posture, networking design, and business continuity readiness across supported platforms.

Each assessment generates structured reports with actionable recommendations, enabling organizations to improve reliability, security, performance, governance, and cost efficiency.

Assessment Scope

  • Workloads: Reviews compute, databases, and application services across platforms such as Azure Virtual Machines, AWS EC2, OCI Compute, Google Compute Engine, Huawei ECS, Azure SQL, AWS RDS, Cloud SQL, Huawei RDS, App Services, Elastic Beanstalk, App Runner, GKE, Huawei CCE, Cloud Run, and FunctionGraph. Provides insights into sizing, utilization, high availability, and optimization opportunities.
  • Security: Evaluates security posture using services such as Microsoft Defender for Cloud, Microsoft Sentinel, AWS security services, OCI security features, Google Security Command Center, and Huawei Host Security and Config. Identifies vulnerabilities, misconfigurations, exposure risks, and provides remediation guidance aligned with industry best practices.
  • Networking: Analyzes network architecture and connectivity including virtual networks, VPCs, VCNs, gateways, firewalls, routing, and hybrid connectivity, and draws every network of a region in the Charts region view. Highlights segmentation gaps, routing issues, and security risks, and provides recommendations to strengthen network design.
  • Business Continuity: Assesses backup configurations, disaster recovery readiness, geo-replication, and failover strategies. Helps ensure workloads can recover quickly and meet organizational RTO and RPO objectives.
  • Cost Optimization: Identifies underutilized resources, oversized instances, unattached storage, and licensing inefficiencies. Provides practical recommendations to reduce cloud spend while maintaining performance and reliability.
  • Governance and Inventory: Builds a structured inventory of cloud assets and evaluates tagging, policy compliance, access control, and subscription or account organization to improve operational control.

Assessment Methodology

RoboMate assessments use automated discovery, cloud APIs, and analytics engines to collect configuration and utilization data. The results are processed through optimization and security logic to generate prioritized recommendations that are easy to understand and implement.

Reports are designed to support architects, cloud engineers, security teams, and decision makers by providing both technical insights and executive-level summaries.

Cost Management

Every assessment collects the cost data of the cloud, and the Cost view of each console shows it with KPI tiles, pies, analytics cards, and click-to-filter bars. Cost reports can be exported from the Reports page.

CloudCost ViewsHighlights
AzureConsumption, Invoices, BudgetsTotal cost, instances, VMs, resource groups, consumed services, top 10 instances, billing period
AWSLast Month, Month before Last, Month before Last 2Total cost, regions, AWS services, start and end of each period
OCIMonthly Usage, Monthly Usage SummaryTotal cost, resources, compartments, services, top 10 resources
Google CloudConsumption (3 months), Invoices, BudgetsCost by service and resource, commitments and reservations
Huawei CloudConsumption (3 months), InvoicesBills by service, yearly/monthly and pay-per-use resources

Charts & Network Topology

The Charts view draws your networks from the last assessment, with the cloud's own icons for every resource.

  • Region View (default for Azure, AWS, OCI, Google Cloud, and Huawei Cloud): all virtual networks of a region together (VNets, VPCs, VCNs), with their subnets, the resources in each subnet, route tables and routes, peerings, hubs and gateways, so you see the whole regional design at a glance.
  • Azure Resource Group Topology: the resources of each resource group and how they connect (VMs with their NICs, disks, public IPs, and NSGs grouped together).
  • Pick a region, zoom and pan, open any resource for its details, and switch between light and dark themes.
  • Export Assessment Charts on the Reports page saves the charts for customer documents.

Reports

The Reports page of each cloud lists every report of the sections above. Choose a report to build it from the last assessment, follow its progress, then preview it in the console (HTML, Excel, Word, PDF) or download it.

  • Modern HTML reports with header logos, information cards, overview bars, search, collapsible sections, details rows, and Back to Top.
  • Your company logo (set in Profile) appears on the reports next to the cloud logo.
  • Export Assessment Data exports the whole assessment to one Excel workbook.
  • Reports work on archived assessments too: restore a previous assessment and report on it.

RoboMate Tools

RoboMate Tools extend the capabilities of RoboMate Cloud Automation by providing specialized planning, estimation, and troubleshooting utilities designed to accelerate cloud architecture, security planning, and operational tasks.

RoboMate Hub

RoboMate Hub is the central workspace that hosts planning, estimation, and troubleshooting modules across multi-cloud environments. It enables architects and engineers to design, size, and document cloud environments efficiently while generating structured outputs for customers and delivery teams.

Landing Zone Hub

  • Azure Landing Zone Hub: Provides a structured interface to design enterprise-grade Azure landing zones aligned with Microsoft Cloud Adoption Framework principles. Includes identity, networking, security, governance, monitoring, connectivity, and management components. Users can define scope and automatically generate:
    • Project scope definition
    • Estimated effort in mandays
    • Structured scope of work documentation
    • Executive summary reports for customers
    Accelerates architecture planning and pre-sales engagements for Azure environments.
  • AWS Landing Zone Hub: Provides a structured interface to design enterprise-grade AWS landing zones aligned with AWS Well-Architected Framework guidance. Includes account structure, networking, security services, identity, governance, monitoring, and connectivity components. Users can define scope and automatically generate:
    • Project scope definition
    • Estimated effort in mandays
    • Structured scope of work documentation
    • Executive summary reports for customers
    Accelerates architecture planning and pre-sales engagements for AWS environments.
  • OCI Landing Zone Hub: Provides a structured interface to design enterprise-grade Oracle Cloud Infrastructure landing zones. Includes compartments, networking, identity, security, governance, monitoring, and connectivity components aligned with OCI architecture best practices. Users can define scope and automatically generate:
    • Project scope definition
    • Estimated effort in mandays
    • Structured scope of work documentation
    • Executive summary reports for customers
    Accelerates architecture planning and pre-sales engagements for OCI environments.

Azure Virtual Desktop Hub

The Azure Virtual Desktop Hub plans AVD projects: host pools and session host sizing, FSLogix profile storage, networking, security, scaling, man-day estimation, and customer-ready scope of work and executive summary documents.

Azure Migration Hub

The RoboMate Azure Migration Hub is a specialized planning tool designed to support Azure migration projects from on-premises or Azure or Azure to Azure. It provides a structured approach to assess workloads, define migration scope, and estimate effort and architecture requirements before execution.

  • Workload Analysis and migration scope planning
  • VM and database migration recommendations
  • Migration strategy definition (Rehost, Replatform, Refactor)
  • Dependency and architecture planning
  • Manday estimation for migration activities
  • Structured scope of work and executive summary generation
  • Full Migration scopping for target Azure environments

This module helps cloud architects and delivery teams accurately plan migrations, reduce risk, and produce clear customer-ready documentation before starting implementation.

Microsoft Sentinel Hub

The Microsoft Sentinel Hub is a specialized planning and sizing tool designed to support SIEM deployments and optimization projects.

  • Data connector planning and selection with the customer
  • Log ingestion estimation and workspace sizing
  • Retention and cost estimation
  • Implementation scope definition
  • Manday estimation for deployment and onboarding
  • Structured outputs for scope of work and executive summaries

This module helps security teams accurately estimate project scope, infrastructure sizing, and operational costs before implementation.

RoboMate Networking Troubleshooting Tools

  • DNS Lookup Tool: Validate DNS records and resolve domain queries quickly.
  • Geo Finder: Identify geographic location and ownership details of IP addresses.
  • Internet Speed Test: Measure download, upload, and latency from the RoboMate machine.
  • Trace Route: Follow the network path to any IP address or DNS name hop by hop.
  • Network Diagnostics Utilities: Assist in troubleshooting connectivity, routing, and name resolution issues during deployments and operations.

RoboMate Certificates Conversion Tool

The SSL Conversion Tool simplifies certificate management by allowing fast conversion between multiple certificate formats used across cloud and networking platforms.

  • .CRT
  • .CER
  • .PEM
  • .PFX
  • .KEY

It also converts PFX to certificate and key files, combines PEM or CRT files with a private key and chain into a PFX, and generates self-signed Root CA and client certificates (for example for VPN point-to-site), showing the equivalent OpenSSL command for every operation.

This module helps engineers quickly prepare certificates for load balancers, application gateways, firewalls, reverse proxies, and web servers without manual command-line processing.

RoboMate Tools are designed to reduce planning time, eliminate estimation errors, standardize documentation, and improve delivery accuracy across multi-cloud environments.

RoboMate Projects

RoboMate Projects keeps your customer delivery in one place: project profiles per client, status donuts (In Progress, Completed, Planned, Due, Archived), man-day summaries, client and owner overviews, a grid view with project files, customer cards, task tracking with completion charts, and budget views with live and forecast figures.

RoboMate AI

RoboMate AI

RoboMate AI is an intelligent assistant integrated within RoboMate Cloud Automation, designed to support engineers, architects, and operations teams with real-time guidance, training, and automation assistance across multi-cloud environments.

By combining structured cloud knowledge, automation logic, and practical implementation guidance, RoboMate AI helps teams accelerate learning, improve decision-making, and reduce troubleshooting time.

RoboMate AI Training

RoboMate AI provides structured technical training designed to help professionals build real-world expertise in cloud architecture, operations, security, and automation.

  • Full RoboMate Training: Comprehensive training covering RoboMate assessments, planning tools, automation profiles, reporting, and operational best practices. Helps users fully utilize the RoboMate platform in customer engagements and production environments.
  • Cloud Expert Training – Microsoft Azure: Covers architecture design, networking, security, governance, monitoring, cost optimization, and operational best practices aligned with enterprise cloud environments.
  • Cloud Expert Training – Amazon Web Services (AWS): Focuses on AWS architecture, networking, security services, workload design, governance, and cost optimization following industry and Well-Architected best practices.
  • Cloud Expert Training – Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI): Covers OCI core services, networking, identity, security, architecture patterns, and operational practices for enterprise-grade deployments.
  • Infrastructure as Code (IaC) Training: Teaches how to automate cloud deployments and operational tasks using tools like ARM Templates, Bicep, Terraform, and CloudFormation. Enables teams to implement repeatable, reliable, and scalable automation for provisioning, configuration, and compliance.

RoboMate AI Search

Every cloud console has AI Search: search the last assessment in plain language (for example "VMs without backup" or "public buckets"), or switch to RoboMate AI Chat to discuss the results, with optional deep responses and export of the answer.

RoboMate AI Assistant

With a premium RoboMate license, users can access the RoboMate AI chat at any time to receive:

  • Technical guidance and architecture recommendations
  • Implementation and troubleshooting assistance
  • Automation suggestions and workflow optimization
  • Best practice recommendations across Azure, AWS, OCI, Google Cloud, Huawei Cloud, and Microsoft 365
  • Support in planning, sizing, and operational decision-making

RoboMate AI acts as an on-demand cloud expert, helping teams reduce research time, accelerate delivery, automate repetitive tasks, and improve the quality and consistency of cloud implementations.

RoboMate AI can be assigned an RFP or project scope and will guide you on how to use RoboMate tools, automations, and best practices to efficiently achieve and successfully deliver the required outcomes.
